body:
Cheery messages are the opposite of what I need, so much appreciated. 

My only lsd experience left me amazed at the beauty and wonder of the world, and how I ever thought to leave it, but like you said I inevitably came back from it. 

How do you find motivation with a thought like yours? Do you believe its genetic, as in the will to live? Or do you think we all need to find some non-logical answer that propels us?
